title: Rule 2: low-risk releases proved and published alone (Piece 3, P3-3)
why: decisions/0179 rule 2, its "Who classifies" line and its note "Piece 3's decisions" (handoffs/piece3-check.md §4). A release names its kind in release.json; ReleaseKind proves it on the server, file against live copy: faq, wording, phone_layout, additive (data_fix recognised, kept in the batch: DB3); nothing touching a Tier 3 area is low-risk. With the switch rule2_autopublish on (the Founder's alone), the site keeps rule 1 and rule 2 itself: a release from git goes live by itself only when today's or yesterday's approved batch names it, or it's a proved low-risk kind the advocates passed; otherwise it waits for the batch (review). Off (as shipped): as before. The Work queue's strip lists what went alone today with Undo (Roll back).
